_meta.purpose: REGRESSION baseline, not a correctness claim -- see tests/test_golden_pipeline.py's module docstring. PRIMARY mode (ekf_auto_pacejka, production default since 2026-09-01): the underlying tyre curve is fit fresh on this data every time modules.tyre_fit_auto.fit_session_pacejka runs -- this golden pins CURRENT fit-chain output, not a frozen prior-session curve.

stability_estimation._comment_expected_sample_rate_hz: Rate guard (2026-08-31, GT3 Paul Ricard investigation -- see thesis_notes.md). Every estimator window in this pipeline was validated at 50 Hz only: yaw_stability_* (Module 5 window/grid/min_samples), nis_gate/tyre_fit_auto's nis_window_samples, kerb_dilation_samples, and longitudinal_stiffness.min_samples_floor's own rate-derivation all assume this car's Cosworth log rate. A file measured at a different rate (confirmed via modules.csv_parser.parse_csv's measured_sample_rate_hz, e.g. a 20 Hz export) is not a smaller/larger version of the same analysis -- prepare_vehicle_state refuses to proceed rather than silently apply 50-Hz-calibrated logic at the wrong scale. Not a calibration tunable to retune per-file: changing this is a decision to validate the whole estimator stack at a new rate, not a per-session setting.
stability_estimation._comment_sideslip_source: WP-N2 Step 1b (2026-08-20): selects which beta feeds Modules 4b/5 at the ui/views/outing_form.py StabilityAnalysisThread call site. PRODUCTION DEFAULT since 2026-09-01: 'ekf_auto_pacejka' (see _comment_sideslip_source_auto_modes below) -- per-session fit, gated, kinematic fallback on gate-fail/degenerate fit. 'kinematic' = production estimate_sideslip, the prior default and still the universal fallback target for every other mode (byte-identical to every session before 2026-09-01). 'ekf_pass_1' = diagnostics/sideslip_ekf_dugoff.py's pass_1 configuration (frozen Dugoff curve, calibrated noise model, carried forward per thesis_notes.md 'WP-N2 carry-forward decision: pass 1'). Traces (CS_ratio, tyre curve, stability) are meaningful under any non-kinematic source immediately; verdict thresholds are NOT re-derived for any of them -- see classification.thresholds_calibrated_for_sideslip_source below, still 'kinematic', so the [UNCAL] banner is expected to show by default until threshold re-derivation lands. Flip to 'kinematic' to isolate a regression; no code edit needed either way.
stability_estimation._comment_sideslip_source_auto_modes: Fresh-session work package (per-session tyre auto-fit + NIS gate wired into production): two additional values. 'ekf_auto_dugoff'/'ekf_auto_pacejka' run modules/tyre_fit_auto.py's fit_session/fit_session_pacejka on THIS session's own data (not a frozen prior-session curve), evaluate modules/nis_gate.py's provisional health gate on the result, and use the fitted EKF's beta_with_fallback only if the gate verdicts 'pass' or 'warn' AND the fit status is not 'degenerate' -- otherwise fall back to kinematic beta, recorded in the analysis payload (fallback_used/fallback_reason), never silently. 'ekf_auto_pacejka' became the production default 2026-09-01 (thesis_notes.md); 'ekf_auto_dugoff' remains available and gated the same way. thresholds_calibrated_for_sideslip_source (below) can never equal either auto value yet -- the [UNCAL] marker and banner apply to both by construction.
stability_estimation._comment_gps_course_anchor: WP5b(c), estimate_sideslip_gps (validation-only, no pipeline call site). Drift-correction anchor gate: a sample qualifies once a short-window-smoothed |ay| stays below max_ay_g for a contiguous run of at least min_duration_s. Data-derived on Dubai (diagnostics/inspect_beta_gps_validation.py): raw per-sample |ay| is too noisy for a literal unbroken-run test (2267 candidate runs at the chosen threshold, longest ~0.1s) -- smooth_window_s=0.3 first was necessary to get physically-sized runs (6 runs >=1.5s, 20.4s total anchor time across 4 laps). max_ay_g=0.05 sits at the moving-sample |ay| p10 (0.044g), a natural low-|ay| population before the distribution rises steeply toward cornering values (p20=0.109g).
stability_estimation.gps_course_latency_s_derived_from: diagnostics/inspect_beta_gps_validation.py, WP5b(c) iteration 1 Section 0: cross-correlation of wrap-safe d(course)/dt against -yaw_rate_radps over lags -1..+1s (racing laps, moving samples) peaks at r=0.9898 at lag=+0.32s, vs r=0.9575 at zero lag -- course-derived rotation consistently lags yaw_rate by this much. A stale course reading recorded at time t describes the vehicle's true state at (t - latency); querying it at (t + latency) recovers the value that actually corresponds to the query instant.
stability_estimation._comment_yaw_stability: Module 5 estimator (modules/yaw_stability.py), after the chair performance_analysis tooling (internal). These are the values the chair pipeline actually runs (its dataclass defaults / default invocation) -- changing any of the six re-triggers classification-threshold re-derivation (WP5b(e) pattern), since thresholds are tuned to this estimator's output distribution.
stability_estimation._comment_cs_fallback: Fallback cornering stiffness references. Derived from axle normal load × C_alpha/Fz = 12 rad^-1 (Milliken & Milliken, RCVD, GT3 slick). Front: (290+290)*9.81*12 = 68268. Rear: (395+381)*9.81*12 = 91343. Used as C_linear_ref when OLS cannot resolve the linear stiffness from data (insufficient alpha excitation on rear axle). Accuracy Level 1. RE-INTRODUCED 2026-08-19 (WP-S4): deleted 2026-07-26 as consumed nowhere in modules/ (thesis_notes.md 'Small-decisions sweep'); re-added verbatim (same values, same original comment above) as the tyre-stiffness prior for diagnostics/sideslip_kalman_observer.py's Kalman sideslip observer candidate (circularity option 2, beta-independent prior -- a fixed, non-alpha-derived Caf/Car instead of the alpha-circular windowed OLS stiffness). Still not consumed by any modules/ production path, diagnostics-only.
